name: Tanco Holdings Berhad
summary: Tanco Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business primarily in Malaysia. It operates through Property Development/Management; Resorts and Club Operation/Management; Construction and Installation; Investment Holding; and Business Consulting Services segments. The company invests, develops, constructs, and manages properties; operates and manages resorts, and golf and marina clubs; operates vacation ownership interval and point based schemes; and acts as a general agent. It also involved in contracting and building works; general trading; trading of construction materials; research and sale of pharmaceutical products; and money lending businesse…
